notes: Permanent Clutter case T7, transcribed from the research materialization PV-TEST-VECTORS-007, accepted by PV-REV-TEST-VECTORS-007. The fixture carries twenty stale branches whose retention semantics are UNCLASSIFIED, so the required conservative superset saturates the whole Clutter vocabulary and an exact possible_bands list is lossless; the general contract stays NON_AUTHORITATIVE_CONSERVATIVE_SUPERSET, and no consumer may read omission from a shorter list as impossibility (issue #22).

vectors.title: Unclassified stale branches are an upper bound on Clutter burden
